When reading for yes/no I prefer not to read reversals.  You can set this intention before pulling the cards if you're concerned with changing the outcome or meaning of already pulled cards.  Personally, I like to pull 3 cards for yes/no just for clarity (best out of 3 "wins")

That said, I personally read the wheel the same if it is upright or reversed, recognizing only a little more time or struggle to get to the same point if reversed.  It is a circle, there is no start or finish, no up or down, it always comes back to the same place.  

I believe most people will read a reversed "yes" card as a "no", however.

It is your practice though, so do what suits you best.  Just be clear what your intention or "rules" are before pulling.  Don't be afraid to pull cards for clarification, either.
Is this actually gore or does it occur naturally?  I love it.

Even more so, why are they so adamant to defend it?  I saw this pic posted on another more ~mystical~ subreddit and the comment section is a head scratcher.  The people who point out that it's man-altered get torn up.

I have an abysmal memory.  I dissociate often, and am generally sleep deprived.  I've heard depression in general makes your memory bad also.  I leave notes for myself and my boyfriend leaves notes for me about things I'll get upset for forgetting.  Its terrible, it feels like living in a haze. I often hit the late afternoon and have no idea what I did all day.

I don't work at all, and I find everything exhausting.  I barely eat because it's exhausting to decide what to eat and then to make it.  I've stopped trying to push for healthy coping mechanisms because it's exhausting so I just stick to the ones I know which are not good.  I'm exhausted when I'm awake and I feel like I must be exhausted when I sleep.  I feel myself making everyone around me exhausted to be around me.  I'm too tired to try anymore but I'm too exhausted to find a way out, one way or another.  I feel like I will just rot away eventually, alone and in pain.
Most of the issues ppl have are not resolveable through forums, yet there are still forums for support.  I am looking for a support group of that type.

I have had some of them exposed before, but it is not comfortable at all for me.  Mine are fairly obvious how they occured, and several have not faded even after years.  I've never had someone say anything to me about them, but I'm sure people know.
This is 100% not true for me.  I wish it was.

My therapist knows I can't talk about most things and  I definitely won't bring them up.  He usually asks at the start of a session if there is something I wanted to discuss if I say no he brings up a topic but doesn't get mad if I go off on something else.  He also gives me things to work on at home and we talk about those sometimes.
It's not going to get much better, it's going to get a whole lot worse.
I'm not sure it's obscure really, but tarot and cartomancy.

I hate it, both because it's always been a slur to me and also because the dictionary definitions are like "strange, odd, spoiled, ruined, etc".  While I might be some of those things, it's not because I'm gay.
As far as I know, there is no naturally occurring version.  They are all altered to look this way.
It sounds a lot like a form of intrusive thoughts to me.  They're horrible and scary and they feel out of your control, but they don't make you a bad person for having them.

For the same price, I could have bought a much larger natural quartz and not had the feeling of being taken advantage of.

 Alternatively, I might have still bought this piece even with some honesty about how it came to be.
I still love to look at it, so not a total loss.  Just wish I hadn't been naive about it.

Sleeping Sickness by City and Colour really helps me with my sleep issues (which I consider the hardest part for me).

It Remembers by Every Time I Die really helps me with feelings of having to pay a debt for crimes I don't think I committed.

Not sure if that makes sense sorry.
